verses.text: Ix ek' jab'xo tiempo, ix b'atxi winhaj Sansón chi' yil ix yetb'eyum chi' yalani, yet'nak jun nok' yune' chiwa winh. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' wanxo syamchajoch sjochchaj ixim trigo. Haxo ix k'och winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh snhi' icha tik: --Tzin nib'ej tzin och wil ix wetb'eyum t'a yol scuarto, xchi winh. Majxo chaji'ochlaj winh yuj winh snhi' chi'.

Anhej to ix yal winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ha hin na'ani to manhxalaj ha gana t'a ix, yuj chi' ix wak' ix t'a jun winh ajun het'ok t'a k'inh chi'. Palta ay wal junxo ix snulej ix tzak'anto t'ay, te ek'b'alto swach'il yilji ix t'a yichanh ix etb'eyum chi', syal ha ix tzik'b'ati, xchi winh snhi' winh chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh t'a winh snhi' chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik jun, max yal-laj skotkan t'a wib'anh yuj tas ol wutok heb' etchonhab' tik yuj hin pakan hin b'a, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winh b'i'an, ix b'at syamankot 300 nok' wa'ax winh, ix stzek'anoch junjun tob'an te taj winh t'a snhe chatakwanh nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al te' winh, ix yaktanb'at nok' winh t'a skal ixim strigo heb' winh filisteo chi'. Masanil ixim kunhkunhb'axo yaj sjochchaji yet' ixim ayto'och t'a yok ix tz'ab'ati. Ix tz'apaxb'at te' uwa yet' te' olivo.

Ix och ijan heb' filisteo sk'anb'anek'i mach ix k'ulan jun chi'. Ix alchaj t'a heb' to ha winhaj Sansón, yujto ix chichon sk'o'ol winh yuj tas ix utaj yuj winh snhi', winh aj Timnat, to ix ik'ji'ek' ix yetb'eyum winh, ix ak'ji ix t'a jun winh ajun yet' winh t'a k'inh yik snupnajel. Yuj chi' ix jawi heb' filisteo snhusantz'a ix ix chi' yet' smam.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Sansón chi' icha tik: --Yujto icha tik ix he k'ulej, yuj chi' manh ol hin och wa'an hex wixtani, masanto ol wak'kanek' hin pak t'ayex, xchi winh.
Ix kot wal yowal winh sik'lab'il, yuj chi' tzijtum anima ix smak'cham winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at kajnaj winh t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a Etam.
Ix jawi heb' winh filisteo sb'ok'e scampamento t'a yol yik Judá t'a slak'anil Lehi.

Ix sk'anb'an heb' winh aj Judá chi' t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj tzex jawi heyak' owal ket'ok? xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh filisteo chi': --Ha winhaj Sansón tzul ko yama', ol kak'anoch syahelal winh, yujto niwan chukal ix yak' winh t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb' winh aj Judá chi', oxe' mil heb' winh ix b'at ilan winhaj Sansón t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a Etam chi', ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh: --¿Tom manh ojtakok to ayonh och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh filisteo tik? ¿Tas yuj tzak'och chukal t'a ko kal yet' heb' winh? xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Icha hin yutej heb' winh, icha pax ix wutej heb' winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Yuj chi' to tzul hach ko tz'ek'b'at tikne'ik yik b'at hach kak'an t'a heb' winh chi', xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winh t'a heb' winh: --Ak'ek he ti' t'ayin an, tato yel manh ol hin he milchamlaj, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ma'ay, manh ol hach ko milchamlaj, anhej to ol hach ko tz'ek'b'ati, b'at hach kak'an t'a heb' winh filisteo chi', xchi heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix stzek'an winh heb' winh t'a chab' ch'anh lasu te ak'to, ix yik'anelta winh heb' winh t'a yol k'e'en nhak'e'en chi'.

Haxo ix k'och heb' winh t'a Lehi chi', ix kot heb' winh filisteo scha heb' winh, toxonhej tz'awaj heb' winh yuj tzalajk'olal. Elanhchamel ix ochxi Yespíritu Jehová t'a winhaj Sansón chi', ix te och yip winh, ix st'inhchitanb'at chab' lasu chi' winh, icha tz'aj snhik'chajb'at junok k'apak k'apak tz'anak, ix em lanhnaj ch'anh t'a sk'ab' winh.
Elanhchamel ix yik'k'e jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru winh, yaxtakto wal jun b'ak chi'. Ha yet' jun b'ak chi', mil heb' winh filisteo chi' ix smak'cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh: Anhej jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru ix wak'lab'ej, kunhkunhb'a ix ajkan heb' chamnak wu'uj. Yujnhej jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru, mil wal winak ix hin mak'chamok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winh, ix sjulankanel jun sb'akil yalanh sti' nok' b'uru chi' winh. Yuj chi' ha jun lugar chi', Ramat-lehi ix sb'i'ejkani, syalelk'ochi, “tzalan b'akil yalanh sti' nok' nok'”.

Ix te takji sti' winhaj Sansón chi', yuj chi' ix yawtej Jehová winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha hach ix ak' wip, yuj chi' ix wak' ganar heb' winh filisteo tik, palta ¿tom ol hin ha cha cham ha hin ha chekab' hin tik yuj takinhti'al t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il tik? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix pak'k'eta jun ha ha' t'a Lehi chi' yuj Jehová. Ix yuk'an ha' winh, ix jax stzalajk'olal winh, ix te ochxi yip winh ix yab'i. Yuj chi', ha jun ha yune' ha' chi', En-hakore ix sb'i'ejkan ha', syalelk'ochi “yuk'b'ila' mach tz'awajk'e'i”. Ha jun ha' chi', ix kannhej ha' t'a Lehi chi'.
Ha winhaj Sansón chi', 20 ab'il ix och winh yajalilok heb' israel chi', yakb'an ayoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' filisteo.
